bruise.what_it_is: A bruise is an area of discolouration caused by small blood vessels under the skin leaking blood after an impact.
immediate_steps: Rest the area and protect it from further injury.
Apply a cold pack wrapped in a cloth for short periods.
avoid: Do not apply ice directly to skin.
Do not massage a fresh bruise.
good_signs: The colour changes and fades over time.
warning_signs: A bruise that appears without a known cause.
Numbness, difficulty moving the area, or worsening symptoms.

burn.what_it_is: A burn is skin damage caused by heat or another source.
immediate_steps: Cool the burn under cool or lukewarm running water for 20 minutes when possible.
Remove jewellery or loose clothing near the burn unless stuck to the skin.
Cover loosely with a clean non-fluffy dressing after cooling.
avoid: Do not use ice, butter, oils, or creams on a fresh burn.
Do not pull away clothing stuck to the burn.
good_signs: The area heals without spreading redness or discharge.
warning_signs: Large, deep, chemical, or electrical burns.
Burns on the face, hands, feet, genitals, or major joints.
White, charred, numb, or leathery skin.

cut.what_it_is: A cut is a break in the skin.
immediate_steps: Apply firm, direct pressure with clean gauze or cloth to control bleeding.
When bleeding is controlled, rinse the wound with clean running water.
Cover with a sterile dressing or clean bandage.
avoid: Do not remove an object embedded in the wound.
Do not repeatedly lift the dressing to check bleeding; add another layer if needed.
good_signs: Redness, pain, and swelling do not worsen.
warning_signs: Signs of infection such as spreading redness, pus, or fever.

materials.name: clean water
safe_uses: Use clean running water to gently rinse a cut.

materials.name: clean cloth
safe_uses: Use a clean cloth to apply direct pressure to bleeding.

materials.name: gauze
safe_uses: Use clean gauze to apply pressure or cover a wound.

materials.name: bandage
safe_uses: Use to cover a minor wound after cleaning.

materials.name: ice pack
safe_uses: Wrap in cloth and apply briefly to a bruise.
avoid: Do not put ice directly on skin or use ice to cool a burn.

materials.name: soap
safe_uses: Use to clean skin around a wound.
avoid: Avoid putting soap deep inside an open wound.
